ch0195_10_ghetsis/0101_0701_01_10:
Well well, what a pleasure to see you
again, [Name:PlayerNickname ].
ch0195_10_ghetsis/0101_0701_02_10:
We seem to run into each other often,
don’t we.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/7101_0701_02_10:
It is said Chien-Pao was born from the
hatred of those who perished by the sword.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/7101_0701_03_10:
I shall harness that hatred—and use it
effectively.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/7102_0701_01_10:
In the past, I tried using Kyurem’s powers
to freeze Unova and rule over all of it.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/7102_0701_02_10:
Now, Chien-Pao’s calamitous power has the
potential to match Kyurem’s!
ch0195_10_ghetsis/7102_0701_03_10:
Next time, my plans shall NOT fail!
You’ll see!
ch0195_10_ghetsis/7103_0701_01_10:
I raised N to be the king of Team Plasma,
but he betrayed me.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/7103_0701_02_10:
He’s an ungrateful, good-for-nothing son,
but thanks to him, I did gain something.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/7103_0701_03_10:
My hatred will become sweet vengeance
one day—without a doubt.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/7104_0701_02_10:
That’s precisely why hate will feed more
hate! It will amplify and grow into a
tremendous power!
ch0195_10_ghetsis/7105_0701_01_10:
I am aware you plan to interfere with me,
[Name:PlayerNickname ].
ch0195_10_ghetsis/7105_0701_02_10:
But I was expecting exactly that kind of
move from you!
ch0195_10_ghetsis/7105_0701_03_10:
Now that I have Chien-Pao, the power of
my hatred is different.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/7105_0701_04_10:
Try as you might, your efforts are futile.
I won’t allow anyone to stop me! No matter
who does what!
ch0195_10_ghetsis/1701_0701_02_10: This is a present for you. Do take it.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/1701_0702_01_10: You may use it as you please.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/2501_0701_01_10: I have a knack for finding useful things.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/2501_0701_02_10:
Finding youths who show promise of
becoming heroes, then tricking them into
being my pawns...
ch0195_10_ghetsis/2501_0702_01_10:
I believe you, too, have the qualities of a
hero—the ability to revolutionize the world.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/2501_0702_02_10: If you wish, I could show you the way.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/2501_0702_03_10:
People and Pokémon can unlock their true
worth by becoming MY tools!
ch0195_10_ghetsis/2511_0701_01_10:
When there is a winner, there must be a
loser. That is how the world operates.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/2511_0701_02_10: Losers harbor a strong, lingering resentment.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/2511_0702_01_10:
Winning battles means glory, but you’ll also
face the losers’ resentment.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/2511_0702_02_10:
Are you prepared to bear the bitterness of
all those you defeat?
ch0195_10_ghetsis/3001_0701_01_10:
Mornings spent with Pokémon shall soon be
put to an end. Anything you do to oppose
me would be in vain.
ch0195_10_ghetsis/3003_0701_01_10:
Hello. Have you properly prepared to accept
Team Plasma’s rightful reign?
ch0195_10_ghetsis/3005_0701_01_10:
Go to sleep ignorant of what lurks in the
night. You’ll be happier that way.
